name: MortgageAccount
description: The live mortgage account created at legal completion (PH-015). Represents the ongoing mortgage liability on the bank's books. Created after CHAPS funds are confirmed as released to the solicitor. Owned by SVC-002. Linked to the customer's current account (ENT-004, SVC-001) via Bacs direct debit for monthly payment collection.

fields.name: property_address
fields.validation_rule: Required. UK address of secured property. Copied from PropertyValuation at completion.

fields.name: outstanding_balance
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal or 0.00, GBP. Initial value = offered_amount. Updated monthly by mortgage ledger process.

fields.name: monthly_payment
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, GBP. Updated when rate changes or after overpayment recalculation.

fields.name: rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Current annual percentage rate. Initially = MortgageOffer.offered_rate. Updated on rate changes.

fields.name: term_remaining
fields.validation_rule: Required. Remaining term in months. Initially = term_years × 12. Decremented monthly.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: active | arrears | redeemed. Transitions: active → arrears (missed payment, MCOB 13 triggered); arrears → active (arrears cleared); active|arrears → redeemed (full redemption).

fields.name: next_payment_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601. Next scheduled direct debit collection date.

fields.name: direct_debit_reference
fields.validation_rule: Required. Bacs direct debit mandate reference. Unique.

fields.name: chaps_payment_reference
fields.validation_rule: Required. CHAPS payment reference for completion funds. Immutable.

relationships.description: MortgageAccount was created from one MortgageOffer.
Bacs DD mandate targets an Account (ENT-004, SVC-001). Reference held as sort code + account number. No direct FK to ENT-004 account_id.
